outcome_detected: In the result, the application is allowed
facts_of_case: The wife prayed for grant of interim maintenance @ Rs.50,000 per month and litigation expenses of Rs.25,000. The husband did not appear in court. The wife was previously granted interim maintenance of Rs.15,000 per month and permanent alimony of Rs.15 lakhs.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the respondent to pay permanent alimony and litigation expenses.
legal_principles.held: We are inclined to allow the application for interim maintenance and direct the respondent to pay a sum of Rs.20,000/-(Rupees twenty thousand only) as permanent alimony from the date of filing of this I.A.

legal_principles.principle: The court may grant interim maintenance and permanent alimony considering the salary of the respondent.
legal_principles.held: Keeping in view the salary of the respondent, which is stated to be Rs.80,000/-(Rupees eighty thousand only) per month, we are inclined to allow the application for interim maintenance...

outcome.final_order: The respondent is directed to pay a sum of Rs.20,000 per month to the appellant from the date of filing of the interim application. The arrear dues be paid in five equal installments along with the current dues.
